title: The Lure
review: An ambitious erotic musical about sirens who leave the sea and find work in a strip club. Maybe this is a loving homage to Polish nightlife in the 80s, but any of that reverence was lost on me. The music was far too cheesy for my tastes, and I was thankful each song was short compared to those of typical West End/Broadway musicals. To my monolingual ear, Polish singing doesn't sound too great, although that might be an issue with the performances themselves. It made me laugh how low the water pressure was as she filled a bath in the white tiled room, and then it cuts to a shot where the tub is full. I imagine the two characters staring at each other with sexual tension, making constant eye contact for two hours as the bath fills. I also liked the double punch.
